frames.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Asset: buildable Overthrow day match concept, a Three.js implementation target.
Art direction: SUN SPELL's flat buttery green, lavender-grey faceted stone and warm peach cloud palette, fine navy ink and confident 1990s Japanese console box-art swagger. Cute proportions with heft and edge, not plush. Simple low-poly stylised code-built geometry with flat colour roles, one warm upper-left light and printed flat shadow ellipses. At most a subtle background cloud plate and a quiet ground grain; do not make a painterly detailed illustration. The court is one nearly uniform butter-green fill, absolutely no floor ink, no cracks, flowers or clutter on playable ground. Thin navy ink on scenery silhouette; thicker navy ink on structures, heroes and minions. Vertical stone faces have a few strata lines and chipped bevels. Moss and sparse apricot plants only on the outer rim. Scenery lavender-grey, muted olive, peach and cream; red and blue saturation exclusively on team units, structure accents and combat tells; gold exclusively on the Ball. White waterfalls shaded lilac, never blue. A sea of pale peach cloud and distant grass-topped stone isles only where the shipped camera sees beyond the rim; a pale moon belongs in a distant sky plate, never fabricate a horizon or force a moon onto the court at this camera.
Map is a SINGLE straight left-to-right lane on a long 104 by 26 metre isle. Blue is left, red right. Preserve all visible collision geometry and exact ground positions from the shipped reference. Four centre pillars at (x,z)=(+-4.5,+-4), extra tower-side pillars at (-13,-3) and (+13,+3). Four cover blocks at x=+-18,z=+-7, each spanning x=+-12 to +-24. Lane 12 m wide, one 5 m flank each side; do not add lanes. Inlay lines no more than 10% darker than floor, no chalk or saturated painted scenery lines. No fort/keep: ONLY one tower at x=-18 and one core at -40 for blue, mirrored +18/+40 for red. Tower: worn, bottom-heavy stone drum, tapered shaft, small team banner and faceted team crystal tip, 4m tall. Core: ONE diamond-shaped faceted team crystal above a stepped stone plinth, 7m, not a castle. Stone bodies remain lavender grey; team colour only on banners, tower tip and core crystal. Never insert structure where reference shows a pillar.
Units are small aggressive stone/bark/enamel/hide creatures with planted stance, an angular brow and small eyes, a horn/beak/notched ear/hooked claw, no blush or glossy big eyes. Fletcher a slim round body, angular beak hood, three quiver arrows; Mitts low square with a giant articulated glove; Carom triangular with open racket; Skip long bar with megaphone. Teams blue/red. Minions 0.6 hero scale, shield/staff/horned hood readable overhead. Team foot discs with dark ink rim, cream outer ring on player; screen-facing ticked HP bars. Ball gold seamed sphere, 1.4m; ground-only circular spawn cue.
Camera and HUD: 1600x900 widescreen, MATCH the FIRST input screenshot camera projection, scale, crop and positions. Camera looks down at 58 degrees, lane horizontal; we see roofs and hats, not portrait faces. Do not zoom out to a miniature whole map or change to a low camera. Preserve the HUD exact positions and smooth finish from screenshot: menu top-left corner, ONE Fletcher player portrait+HP+XP frame top-left beneath it, one slim rounded cream top-centre pill, blue three dots / kills / clock / Ball seconds / red kills and three dots, three standalone Q W E tiles bottom-centre, the actual long single-lane minimap bottom-right and inspect controls top-right. Readouts are smooth, no torn paper; frame+offset shadow for clickable controls only. Do not copy Sun Spell's three portrait cards or top-right square minimap, its floor clutter or soft creatures. No logos, poster titles, captions, inset panels or montage. ONE actual playable screen per output.
Inputs: Image 1 shipped Overthrow midfield camera/layout/HUD reference; edit this image. Image 2 picked Sun Spell match style reference ONLY for palette, ink and stone, NOT its layout/camera/units/UI.
Frame 1: ESTABLISHING SHOT, quiet opening moment at mid. Preserve Image 1 exact four midfield pillar centres, pillar heights, central circle scale and edge-cover locations. Remove the debug sidebar and expand scene behind it, retaining HUD. Transform the four plain grey cylinders into chipped lavender stone drums with pale caps, still the same size and position. Transform the visible cover at outer frame edges into low chipped stone with moss tops, no tall vegetation. A blue Fletcher and two tiny shield minions approach mid from left; a red Fletcher and two tiny minions from right, generous space between groups. No active spells. Establish the quiet playable ground and the strong, thick-inked creature silhouettes. Keep structures beyond this crop off-screen; their correct positions are shown on long minimap. It is fine that this tight camera shows mostly floor: do NOT fake a whole floating island vista to show the scenery. Aim for a crisp 3D comic-sticker in-game render, vivid combatants on a muted butter-green court, very few textures.
frames.correction: Edit this establishing frame with a small rendering correction. Preserve camera, crop, geometry positions, HUD, hero designs, four central pillars and the whole lane layout exactly. Make the court a SINGLE uniform muted butter-green flat fill with only extremely subtle luminance grain, no mottled watercolour, gradients or grass texture. Change ALL white circle/centre/lane markings to faint worn stone inlays only about 8% darker than the floor, unoutlined. Keep them at the same positions and widths. Eliminate ALL flowers and grass blades on the inner cover blocks; these collision blocks can have a simple moss-colour flat top but no protruding foliage on playable floor. Tower-side and midfield stone remain chipped faceted lavender grey. The heroes' horned/beaked hoods are bone/ivory, their bows worn muted wood, not saturated gold; GOLD is reserved for the Ball only. Blue and red team FOOT DISCS must be solid flat blue/red circles with navy rim, visible under feet; only the blue PLAYER's foot disc has a cream outer ring. Red enemy hero must have no cream outer ring. Give minions angular brows and tiny eyes, remove large glossy eyed plush appearance. Keep blocky material and bold ink. Remove stray orange/gold decorative shield badges, use ivory/navy. Add the three small smooth cream inspect/control buttons to TOP-RIGHT in their shipped positions, with navy borders; don't move any other HUD. Everything else unchanged. One crisp 16:9 in-game screenshot, not a poster.

A gold SEAMED BALL 1.4m diameter is carried above the RED Mitts at left-lower side of the central fight, conspicuous but not enormous. Visible action: ONE enemy red outline with 30% red fill STRAIGHT rectangular telegraph pointing leftwards from red Fletcher; ONE player's cream-filled navy-edged narrow rectangle directed toward red Fletcher from blue Fletcher. Flat team-tells and unit discs are the most saturated and highest contrast marks; ground inlays nearly invisible by comparison. Pillars/cover remain the quieter scenery. Saturated gold belongs only to the Ball, shields have muted ivory/navy bosses, beaks/bows bone and muted wood. Cream circles only on player, not every unit.
Aim for a crisp three.js low-poly comic-sticker gameplay screenshot with 90s swagger, not painterly boxart. Preserve Image 2 establishing's exact visual world and HUD.

Both have compact navy-rimmed ticked blue HP bars without framed labels. A navy split crack in the tower stone and a barely noticeable lean show age and mass, no extra rings or glowing clutter. Tower banner hangs close to shaft, no cloth physics implied.
The long base walls clipped along upper-left and lower-left become coursed lavender stone with soft joints and pale paved tops; existing upper-right and lower-right lane cover becomes low flat-topped chipped stone with plain muted moss top. No extruded foliage on court/cover. Base throat and walkable lane positions stay unchanged.
